heading: Wednesday, November 12, 2025
topLine: DeepMind publishes AlphaProof methodology in Nature. Also: OpenAI releases GPT-5.1 Instant and Thinking.

items.headline: DeepMind publishes AlphaProof methodology in Nature
items.summary: Google DeepMind published the method behind AlphaProof in Nature. AlphaProof is an AlphaZero-style agent that learns to find Lean proofs through reinforcement learning on millions of autoformalized problems, and it uses test-time RL for the hardest problems. The paper documents the IMO 2024 result: three of the five non-geometry problems solved, which with AlphaGeometry 2 gave silver-medal-level performance after multi-day computation.

items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-5.1 Instant and Thinking
items.summary: GPT-5.1 updates the GPT-5 series in ChatGPT with a warmer default Instant model that can choose to reason on harder questions, and a Thinking model that adapts reasoning time to the question. It added tone presets; API access followed on November 13.
